page.title: Account
page.subtitle: Profile, password, and account deletion
page.guestSubtitle: You’re signed in as a guest. Your lists and history are stored on the server.
page.guestSaveHint: Add an email and password to sign in from any device. Your lists and purchases stay where they are.

password.title: Change password
password.description: Enter your current password and choose a new password.
password.googleNoticeBody: You sign in with Google, so there is no separate ClickMoji password.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Your account, lists, history, favorites, and products you added will be deleted permanently.
delete.passwordPrompt: Enter your current password to confirm.
delete.deletedBody: Your account and data have been deleted. You are signed out.
